messages.subject: Saxena - initial thoughts on strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Having read the grievance, my instinct is that this is a genuine whistleblowing exposure and not one we'd want in front of a Tribunal - uncapped, no qualifying period, and the disclosures are contemporaneous and in writing. Let's pull the service agreement and the Oct-Dec correspondence and pressure-test causation on the note of concern. Can you draft an advice note for the Board for early next week?

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

messages.snippet: Agreed. The note of 8 January following so soon after the December disclosure is the real problem -
messages.subject: RE: Saxena - initial thoughts on strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
Agreed. The note of 8 January following so soon after the December disclosure is the real problem - hard to characterise as anything but reactive. I'll have a draft advice note to you Monday. I think we recommend (a) settle, and (b) commission an independent technical review so the safety point is dealt with on its merits and can't be said to have been bought off. Prospects of defending the detriment claim I'd put no higher than 40%.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
